common.name: Name
common.disclaimer: Certidrill is an independent website. It is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Microsoft. Microsoft and Azure are trademarks of the Microsoft group of companies. All questions are original and written from public documentation; none comes from a real exam.

home.title: Practice exams that feel like the real thing
home.subtitle: Timed mock exams with locked sections, case studies, a review screen and a score out of 1000 — then a detailed, explained correction.
home.closed: Registrations are currently closed: accounts are created by the administrator.

features.realistic: Realistic sessions: 100 minutes, 45 to 58 questions, every question format of the real exam.
features.variety: Several distinct mock exams, without repeating questions while the bank allows it.
features.report: Overall score, score per domain and an explained correction linked to Microsoft Learn.
features.progress: Progress tracking to know when you are ready.

login.title: Sign in to Certidrill
login.magicHelp: Receive a single-use sign-in link by e-mail. Also use it if you forgot your password, then change it in your account.
login.sent: If an account exists for this address, a sign-in link has been sent. It expires in 15 minutes.
login.forgot: Forgot your password? Use the magic link.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.

question.yesNoCaption: For each statement, select Yes if the statement is true, otherwise select No.
question.meetsGoal: Does this solution meet the goal?
question.seriesNotice: This question is part of a series that presents the same scenario. Each question has a different solution. You cannot return to a question once answered.
question.hotPrompt: Select a prompt, then click the matching area.
question.dragInstructions: Press Space or Enter to pick up an item, use the arrow keys to move it over a target, then press Space or Enter again to drop it.

exam.duration: Duration: {n} minutes. The timer starts when you click Start and does not stop, even if you close the page.
exam.sectionsCase: Case studies: once you leave a case study, you cannot return to it.
exam.sectionsSeries: Yes/No series: each answer is final; you cannot go back.
exam.sectionsMain: Main section: you can move freely, flag questions for review and use the review screen before finishing.
exam.noHints: No pause, no hints, and no correction before the end.
exam.shortBank: The question bank is still small: this exam contains {n} questions instead of the {min}–{max} of the real exam.
exam.question: Question {n} of {total}
exam.finishConfirm: Finish the exam? You will not be able to change your answers.

exam.leaveCaseConfirm: Leave this case study? You will not be able to return to it.

exam.seriesConfirm: Your answer is final: you will not be able to come back to this question.
exam.seriesChoose: Select Yes or No to continue.
exam.reviewHelp: Select a question to go back to it. Then finish the exam.
exam.warning: {n, plural, one {# minute left.} other {# minutes left.}}
exam.timeUp: Time is up: your exam has been submitted.
exam.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
exam.resumeNotice: Exam resumed. Time elapsed while you were away has been counted.
exam.leaveSectionConfirm: Finish this section? You will not be able to return to these questions; the exam continues with the next section.
exam.unsavedRetry: Some answers are not saved yet (connection problem). Check your connection and try again.

results.title: Score report
results.status_expired: Submitted automatically when time ran out
results.approx: This score is an approximation: Microsoft uses a scaled score whose formula is not public. Here, score = 1000 × points earned / points possible.
results.whyNot: Why the other choices are wrong
